OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Model Set for Wider Release After US Approval

OpenAI is preparing to launch its advanced GPT-5.6 artificial intelligence model for public access this week. This follows a period of restricted rollout and government testing in the United States. The US government has reportedly lifted previous restrictions, clearing the way for a broad release of the powerful AI technology.
